# LGSolutionsfor  EverySpace

Delivering next-generation applications and creating stunning visual solutions for wide-ranging applications

Scroll to bottom of the hero section

![, LG Display technology has the advanced and flexible commercial display solutions to fulfill your business needs.](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Corporate_Lobby.png)

LG B2B Solutions provide flexible, innovative products that are easy to integrate and can be customized to create sustainable levels of growth and value for solving your most critical business challenges.

With a reputation for excellence and technology innovation, LG Display technology has the advanced and flexible commercial display solutions to fulfill your business needs.

As the world’s largest and most trusted AV integrator, AVI-SPL partners with innovative visual collaboration technology manufacturers—like LG—to give you access to advanced, secure, and effective AV and digital signage solutions.

[Contact Us](https://avispl.com/lg/#contact)

![From retail and restaurants to healthcare, education, hospitality, and corporate environments, LG helps organizations communicate more effectively, enhance customer experiences, and strengthen their brand presence.](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Corporate_Intro.png)

### Solutions

LG is a global leader in display innovation, trusted by businesses across industries to deliver impactful, reliable, and easy-to-manage digital signage solutions. From retail and restaurants to healthcare, education, hospitality, and corporate environments, LG helps organizations communicate more effectively, enhance customer experiences, and strengthen their brand presence.

[Contact Us](https://avispl.com/lg/#contact)

![LG Direct View LED displays](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Corporate_Large-Meeting-Room.png)

### LG Direct View LED Displays: Immersive Visual Performance for Every Environment

LG Direct View LED displays transform any space into a show-stopping visual experience. With stunning brightness, razor-sharp detail, and a seamless canvas that scales to any size, LG DVLED is built to grab attention and elevate your brand.

- From corporate lobbies to retail flagships to world-class venues, LG delivers the premium performance, reliability, and wow-factor that modern environments demand.
- **Impactful Visuals**: Ultra-smooth, bezel-free screens create larger-than-life displays that stop people in their tracks.
- **Brilliant Color & Clarity**: High brightness and rich color reproduction make your content pop—even in bright ambient lighting.
- **Custom-Fit for Any Space**: With multiple pixel pitches and a modular design, LG DVLED builds the exact display your space needs—from meeting rooms to massive feature walls.
- **Reliable, Long-Life Operation**: Engineered for commercial use with redundant systems available to minimize downtime- so your message never goes dark.
- **Fast Install, Easy Upkeep**: Front serviceability and lightweight cabinets simplify installation and maintenance, keeping your display looking flawless with minimal effort.

##### Ultimate Business Display

Available in various sizes and performance levels, the LG Direct View LED ultimate business display takes the guesswork out of configuring a display that’s right for your business. From 2K to 8K resolutions with 16:9 screen sizes from 81” to a showstopping 325” (measured diagonally), this display comes with all the components you need to dynamically deliver your content on a jaw-droppingly vibrant, magnificent screen.

##### All-in-One DVLED

Elevate your lobby, lecture hall, or meeting room with LG Direct View LED All-in-One Displays. Easy installation, stunning clarity, and everything you need for setup and maintenance are conveniently packed in a custom wheeled flight case. With an embedded controller, built-in speaker and incredible image quality, it’s brilliance you have to see to believe.

##### LG MAGNIT Micro LED

Enhanced technology that delivers breathtaking viewing experiences, immersing you in vivid colors and ultrafine details that elevate your work and surroundings. Transform your space into an elegant and enriched environment with LG MAGNIT’s immersive visuals, and experience the cutting-edge of LG Micro LED display technology. From All-in-one to custom sizes, LG MAGNIT is perfect for lobbies, conference rooms, auditoriums, control rooms, virtual production, home cinema, and more.

##### Experts and Eco Systems Partners

We offer a wide range of Ecosystem partners to maximize hardware/software/services integration, on-site consultation with solution architects, service engineers and installation supervision, and experienced teams with a deep understanding of commercial spaces.
